title: 第11章 亏呀一剑过后什么都没有了第12章 人性挣扎 舍弃亦是成全
content_zh:
“勇气可嘉，果真是初生牛犊不怕虎。”红衣队长看了半天自是看出了郑风的一些门道。
郑风两次激怒自己的手下，出其不意的斩下了众人持枪的手掌，还伤了坐下的骏马。利用阵法禁锢几位手下。这些都算不得什么，说明郑风武力值并不高，对付一些初阶武君和高阶天神也要用智谋和阵道辅助。
在红衣队长看来，阵风完全不是自己的对手，自己刚才的蓄势待发看来是过于谨慎了。
“既然你要切磋，不妨小试一把。”红衣领队口里说得毫不经意，但蓄势完成的他，并不像他口中说得小试，而是全力出击。长枪在空中划出一道弧线，速度之快，力道之猛。
空气因快速摩擦发出尖锐的鸣叫，枪尖上都能看到与空气剧烈摩擦产生的火花。
““霸王刺”就是第一道小试。”红衣领队对自己的攻击很是满意，不忘自得地介绍了一下。
郑风看得清楚，迎着枪尖打出一拳，“风雷拳”，一声大喝，神力随拳头出击猛烈爆发，雷霆巨力增幅，风神力增速下，伴随着狂风呼啸雷霆炸响，一个硕大的拳头虚影如同实质，瞬间打爆枪头的神力产生的锋锐罡气。连红衣队长的枪尖也打断了。
红衣队长惊呆了，不过看到郑风也长大嘴巴，就以为郑风在嘲笑自己，顿觉颜面扫地，十分气恼。从储物戒里又取出一杆长枪。
这把枪更加闪亮，黝黑的枪身，发出幽幽的光晕，枪尖深红嗜血，锋利异常，一看就是沾染过许多鲜血的宝器，红衣队长异常珍视，轻易不动用，现在看来是十分重视郑风这个对手。
其实郑风真没有嘲笑的意思，他张大嘴巴也只是十分惊异风雷拳到神界的变化。
那拳头虚影，以前是没有的，以前即便融合“天武灵剑诀”的一些思路，采用多次聚力和叠加的手法进行拳法增幅，也没有拳头虚影，如今这个虚影近乎实质，惊诧后就是惊喜！
看到红衣领队的严阵以待，郑风莫名有些兴奋，对，就是兴奋，满脸通红，眼神跃跃欲试。
“蛟龙出海”红衣领队先发出攻击，后才猛然大喝，明显不是提醒郑风，而是增加自己的气势。
长枪震动蜿蜒前行，看似缓慢也没有刚才霸王刺的华丽弧线，但几个起伏，长枪所过，爆鸣声不断，足见威力惊人。
“这一枪很是精妙，利用震动，小弧度冲击，同时聚力，一道道叠加，不仅冲刺力量惊人，攻击目标后震动幅度带来的破坏力更是威力无穷，防不甚防啊！”郑风十分欣赏红衣队长的攻击方式。
迎头就施展“一往无前”破掉枪尖的冲刺，接连就是“峰回路转”，对应的是长枪震动带来的弧线波动。
为了能继续，郑风并没有运用“峰回路转”将伤害还给红衣队长，而是看似力不从心的带偏长枪的力道而已。
红衣队长不知道郑风的意图，还真的以为郑风疲于应付，难免有些得意。
“不错，你接下了第二招，就再来一招。”红衣队长一贯的先出招后出声。人一旦长久以来做事思路形成习惯，是一时改变不了的。
明是一盆火，暗是一把刀，表面与人谈笑风生，暗地偷偷出杀招，红衣队长在这方面特别优秀。

郑风感觉对方的杀招劈面而来，没有觉得对方卑鄙，大家都心知肚明，这并不是一场友好的切磋。
长枪初看和第二招攻势一样，细细感应却是暗藏玄机，包藏祸心，这次震动更加猛烈，但游走的弧度变小，聚力更刁钻，力道紧贴枪尖冲刺力，几乎合二为一。
这明显是为了避开郑风的第二式“峰回路转”，想通过巨大的力道，让“峰回路转”无法转移。
这给郑风出了一个难题，既要防住红衣队长长枪尖点的冲刺，又要防住枪身震动的辐射伤害，关键郑风是拿红衣队长来磨练自身，躲避并非上策。
”万方来拜“郑风剑气如虹，万道剑气冲击而出，如同一个巨大屏障，对应碰撞，很快这道屏障就被长枪的震动辐射力破开了，一道冲刺力破空而来。自认自己的阴谋得手，红衣队长得意不已。
”哈哈，谁说这一式就是上一式的“蛟龙出海”，这是增加了力度的“金枪钻”，让你防不胜防。“
郑风自然没有想仅凭”万方来拜“这个如巨盾防御的方式去狙击所有的攻击，紧接一道”一往无前“剑招施展开来，一道猛烈的剑气，呼啸而出，无畏无惧。
这一招令郑风想起以前的顿悟，那就是剑道心境上的升华，剑道无止境，无畏又无惧。
郑风的剑道一直是走的融合之道，“一往无前”并不只是“天武灵剑诀”的第一式，还融合了“风雷剑诀”风的速度和万般变幻，雷霆破坏和毁灭，金的坚韧和锋锐，木的无限生机和绵延不绝，水的鲜活灵动和无孔不入，火的灼烧毁灭和催发新生，土的厚实稳重和强大防御。
郑风灵魂本源灵光乍现。这一剑，一往无前，无惧无畏，这一剑，锋锐霸道，生生不息。
郑风陷入了明悟，一剑出，他没去管在一旁的红衣队长，这时候郑风的眼里没有对红衣队长的神力渴求，没有对储物戒的贪恋，有的是一个剑者强大的无敌自信。
脑海中尽是风雷剑内白衣剑客的高山仰止，云淡风轻，无敌的信念，手中无剑，心中无剑，吾又何须要剑，吾就是剑，天地间独一无二的剑！”
郑风的自信也不是没有理由，刚才的一剑是触发风雷剑明悟的一剑，“风雷剑诀”是融合的剑诀，走的吸收众剑诀之长的融合之道，同时也是吸收武道中各种招式所长。
现在的明悟是风雷剑的融合还是各种神力的融合发挥，集众神力之优势，施展风雷剑，运用“风雷剑诀”那又是何种景象？
郑风记得塔灵大哥提醒，风雷剑并非凡物，郑风自己评估应该比昊天塔等级还高，昊天塔都不能轻易示人，何况是风雷剑。
郑风有一种自信，那就是自己现在即便不用风雷剑，就是剑指也威力巨大。
若能把自己已拥有的七种神力加以壮大，融合各神力之长，对，就是融合各神力之长而不是简单融合各种神力，这是自己未来剑道的方向。
融合是主旋律，但应各取所长。融合的路还很长，现在已有了明确的方向。
郑风一番明悟后非常感激红衣队长，正要感谢红衣队长的神助攻，不然自己也无法在情急之下触发十分难得的明悟。
看到“天地牢笼”禁锢下的一众断手骑士，一脸惊恐的神情，郑风诧异地看向红衣队长。

郑风不由得一手扶额，一脸痛苦，亏，太亏，亏大了！
一个中阶武君呀！那充沛的神力，那黝黑的神枪，那一身装备，还有储物戒里所有的好东西呀，都没了。
一剑之威，郑风明悟的时候没有看到，但一剑过后的损失，郑风看得真切，感受得实在，这么多好东西，就一剑败光了呀！
想想那晶石给自己感受的舒爽，郑风头痛，心痛，肝也痛！
content_en:
"Your courage is commendable. It's true that a newborn calf is not afraid of tigers." The captain in red looked for a long time and saw some of Zheng Feng's skills.
Zheng Feng twice angered his men, and unexpectedly cut off everyone's gun-holding palms, and also injured the horse that was sitting down. Use the formation to imprison several subordinates. These are nothing, which shows that Zheng Feng's force value is not high, and he still needs the help of wisdom and formation to deal with some junior warriors and high-level gods.
From the perspective of the captain in red, Rafale was no match for him, and his preparation for attack just now seemed to be too cautious.
"Since you want to compete, you might as well give it a try." The leader in red said it casually, but when he was ready to finish, it was not a small test as he said, but an all-out attack. The spear drew an arc in the air with great speed and fierce force.
The air made a sharp scream due to the rapid friction, and the sparks caused by the violent friction with the air could be seen on the tip of the gun.
"The "Overlord Thorn" is the first test." The leader in red was very satisfied with his attack and introduced it proudly.
Zheng Feng could see it clearly. He punched the tip of the gun, "Wind and Thunder Fist", and with a loud shout, his divine power exploded violently with his fist. The power of thunder increased. As the power of the wind increased, accompanied by the howling of the wind and the explosion of thunder, the shadow of a huge fist became as real as the substance, instantly blasting the sharp aura generated by the divine power of the gun head. Even the tip of the red captain's spear was broken.
The captain in red was shocked, but when he saw Zheng Feng also had a big mouth, he thought Zheng Feng was laughing at him, and suddenly felt humiliated and very angry. He took out another long gun from the storage ring.
This gun shines even more brightly, with a dark body emitting a faint halo. The tip of the gun is crimson and bloodthirsty, and is extremely sharp. At first glance, it looks like a treasure stained with a lot of blood. The captain in red cherishes it very much and does not use it easily. Now it seems that he attaches great importance to Zheng Feng as an opponent.
In fact, Zheng Feng really didn't mean to laugh. He opened his mouth wide because he was just very surprised at the changes from the Wind and Thunder Fist to the God Realm.
That fist phantom did not exist before. In the past, even if some ideas from the "Tian Wu Ling Sword Technique" were integrated, and multiple force gathering and superposition techniques were used to increase the fist skills, there was no fist phantom. Now this phantom is almost real, and after the surprise, it is a surprise!
Seeing the leader in red preparing for the battle, Zheng Feng was inexplicably excited. Yes, he was excited. His face was red and his eyes were eager to try.
"The dragon goes out to sea." The leader in red attacked first and then shouted loudly. It was obviously not to remind Zheng Feng, but to increase his own momentum.
The spear vibrated and meandered forward. It seemed slow and did not have the gorgeous arc of the Overlord's stab just now. However, after several ups and downs, the spear passed by and made continuous explosions, which showed its amazing power.
"This shot is very exquisite. It uses vibration, small arc impact, and simultaneous accumulation of force to superimpose one after another. Not only is the sprinting power amazing, but the destructive power caused by the vibration amplitude after attacking the target is even more powerful. It is difficult to guard against it!" Zheng Feng admired the red captain's attack method very much.
Head-on, he performs an "indomitable" sprint to break the tip of the spear, followed by a "turnaround", which corresponds to the arc fluctuations caused by the vibration of the spear.
In order to continue, Zheng Feng did not use "turnaround" to return the damage to the red captain, but just deflected the force of the spear that seemed to be beyond his ability.
The captain in red didn't know Zheng Feng's intentions. He really thought that Zheng Feng was tired of dealing with it, so he was inevitably a little proud.
"That's right. If you take the second move, you'll do another one." The captain in red always struck first and spoke later. Once a person has formed a habit of doing things for a long time, he cannot change it for a while.
He is a pot of fire and a knife. He talks and laughs with people on the surface, but secretly makes killing moves. The red captain is particularly good at this aspect.
Zheng Feng felt that the other party's killing move was coming towards him, but he did not think that the other party was despicable. Everyone knew that this was not a friendly competition.
At first glance, the spear looks the same as the second offensive move., careful sensing revealed a hidden mystery and evil intentions. This time, the vibration was more violent, but the arc of movement became smaller, and the concentration of force was more cunning. The force was close to the sprinting force of the spear tip, almost becoming one.
This is obviously to avoid Zheng Feng's second style "Turn and Turn", and to use huge force to make the "Turn and Turn" unable to be transferred.
This posed a difficult problem for Zheng Feng. He had to prevent the red-coated captain from charging at the sharp point of his spear, and he also had to prevent the radiation damage caused by the vibration of the gun body. The key was that Zheng Feng used the red-coated captain to test himself, and avoiding it was not the best option.
"Wan Fang Comes to Worship" Zheng Feng's sword energy was like a rainbow. Ten thousand sword energy rushed out, like a huge barrier, corresponding to the collision. Soon the barrier was broken by the shock radiation force of the spear, and a sprint force broke through the air. Thinking that his plot was successful, the captain in red was very proud.
"Haha, who said this move is the "dragon going out to sea" of the previous move? This is the "golden gun drill" with increased strength, making you hard to guard against. "
Zheng Feng naturally did not want to snipe all attacks with the giant shield defense method of "Wan Fang Lai Bai". Then he launched the "Indomitable Forward" sword move, and a fierce sword energy roared out, fearlessly and fearlessly.
This move reminded Zheng Feng of his previous epiphany, which was the sublimation of the state of mind of swordsmanship. There is no limit to swordsmanship, fearlessness and fearlessness.
Zheng Feng's swordsmanship has always followed the path of fusion. "Forward Indomitably" is not only the first move of the "Tianwu Ling Sword Technique", but also incorporates the speed and changes of the "Wind and Thunder Sword Technique" of wind, the destruction and destruction of thunder, the tenacity and sharpness of metal, the infinite vitality and endless stretch of wood, the vividness and pervasiveness of water, the burning destruction and regeneration of fire, and the thickness, stability and strong defense of earth.
The origin of Zheng Feng's soul suddenly appeared. This sword moves forward without any fear. This sword is sharp and domineering, never ending.
Zheng Feng fell into enlightenment and struck out with his sword. He ignored the captain in red who was standing by. At this time, Zheng Feng's eyes did not have the desire for the captain in red's divine power, nor the greed for the storage ring, but the invincible self-confidence of a swordsman.
In my mind, I can see the swordsman in white in the Wind and Thunder Sword looking up at the mountain, the clouds are light and the wind is light, the invincible belief, there is no sword in my hand, there is no sword in my heart, why do I need a sword, I am the sword, the unique sword in the world! "
Zheng Feng's confidence is not without reason. The sword just now was the sword that triggered the enlightenment of the Wind and Thunder Sword. The "Wind and Thunder Sword Art" is a fusion sword art. It absorbs the strengths of all sword art and absorbs the strengths of various moves in martial arts.
Is the current Mingwu the fusion of wind and thunder swords or the fusion and exertion of various divine powers? What kind of scene would it be like to gather the advantages of all the divine powers to display the wind and thunder swords and use the "wind and thunder sword techniques"?
Zheng Feng remembered that Brother Ta Ling reminded him that the Wind and Thunder Sword was not an extraordinary object. Zheng Feng himself estimated that it should be higher than the level of Haotian Tower. Even the Haotian Tower could not show it to others easily, let alone the Wind and Thunder Sword.
Zheng Feng has a kind of confidence that even if he doesn't use the Wind and Thunder Sword now, his sword finger is still very powerful.
If you can strengthen the seven kinds of divine power you already have and integrate the strengths of each divine power, yes, it means integrating the strengths of each divine power instead of simply integrating various divine powers. This is the direction of your future swordsmanship.
Fusion is the main theme, but each should draw on its strengths. The road to integration is still long, but now we have a clear direction.
After Zheng Feng realized something, he was very grateful to the captain in red. He was about to thank the captain in red for his divine assist, otherwise he would not have been able to trigger this rare enlightenment in a desperate situation.
Seeing the frightened expressions on the faces of the knights with severed hands imprisoned in the "Heaven and Earth Cage", Zheng Feng looked at the red captain in surprise.
Zheng Feng couldn't help but put his hand on his forehead, with a look of pain on his face, "Loss, too much loss, big loss!"
An intermediate martial lord! The abundant divine power, the dark magic gun, the equipment, and all the good things in the storage ring are gone.
The power of a sword, Zheng Feng did not see it when he realized it, but Zheng Feng could clearly see and feel the loss after one sword strike. So many good things were lost with one strike!
Thinking about the comfort that crystal gave him, Zheng Feng had a headache, heartache, and liver pain!
